title: ToolACE-MT: Non-Autoregressive Generation for Agentic Multi-Turn Interaction
claim: Prior methods generate trajectories turn by turn through sequential multi-agent interaction; ours drafts a whole trajectory and refines it in parallel.
layout: 2 panels side by side; left sequence diagram vs right staged flow with nested loop
description: A two-panel figure split by a thin vertical line. Panel (a), Multi-Agent Simulation, shows three lifelines (User, Assistant, Tool) with icons at the top. Curved arrows between them are labeled Query, Ask, More Info, Call, Output, More Calls and Summary, which depicts sequential back-and-forth turns. A brace at the bottom leads to Check and Finalization. Panel (b), Non-Autoregressive Generation, runs top to bottom. An Initialization row shows a full chain of user, assistant and tool icons. Below it, a large rounded box labeled Iterative Refinement contains two sub-boxes for the Two Alternative Ops, Mask & Extend and Mask & Fill. In these, dark blue masked squares are replaced by dashed-outline filled icons. A final arrow leads to Check and Finalization. The palette is navy and light blue. The eye goes first to the icon rows and the nested refinement box.
caption: Multi-Agent Simulation v.s. our proposed Non-Autoregressive Generation.
abstract: Agentic task-solving with Large Language Models (LLMs) requires multi-turn, multi-step interactions, often involving complex function calls and dynamic user-agent exchanges. Existing simulation-based data generation methods for such scenarios rely heavily on costly autoregressive interactions between multiple LLM agents, thereby compromising the practical efficiency of agentic data generation. In this paper, we propose ToolACE-MT, a novel Non-Autoregressive Iterative Generation framework for constructing high-quality multi-turn agentic dialogues. ToolACE-MT generates full conversational trajectories through three stages: coarse-grained initialization, iterative refinement, and offline verification. The initialization phase builds a structurally complete yet semantically coarse dialogue skeleton; the iterative refinement phase introduces realistic complexities and continued refinement via mask-and-fill operations; and the offline verification phase ensures correctness and coherence via rule- and model-based checks. Experiments demonstrate that ToolACE-MT enables efficient, effective and generalizable agentic data generation, offering a new paradigm for high-quality data construction in tool-augmented LLM scenarios.
